question: Which of these ragas is traditionally associated with the early morning and evokes a peaceful, meditative mood?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raga Bhairav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Raga Bhairav** is traditionally associated with the **early morning**. It is believed to evoke a **peaceful and meditative mood**, making it suitable for the serene hours of dawn.
 
• This raga is considered one of the foundational ragas in Indian classical music and belongs to the **Bhairav Thaat**.
 
• The raga is characterized by the use of **Komal Re (flattened second note) and Komal Dha (flattened sixth note)**, which gives it a unique and serious aura.
 
• **Bhairav** is often referred to as a "morning raga," and it is believed that its rendition during the early hours creates a tranquil and introspective atmosphere.
